text:
ellie: Quick pass on Dusk tokens — small follow-up from yesterday. Figma: https://figma.redwood/design/dusk-v2. Main asks: tighten code/inline contrast, make sparklines readable on 13" MacBook, and avoid red/green reliance in charts.

sam: Noted. Saw screenshots. On 13" the thin sparkline (1px) disappears against the bg. Recommend 1.5-2px stroke in dark theme and a 10% filled area under small charts for context.

anya: Contrast numbers: comment token at #6B767D vs bg #0f1416 -> ~3.3:1. Suggest bump to #78848B for ~4.6:1. Also badge hover needs lift (current ~3.2:1).

rachel: UX copy nit: toggle shows "Dark". Product prefers named themes. Suggest "Theme: Dusk" and tooltip: "Dusk — balanced contrast for code and charts". Keeps clarity for users who toggle multiple themes.

ellie: Proposed minimal token diffs: comment -> #78848B, badge-hover -> #C0CDD6, sparkline-stroke -> 2px, code-font-weight -> 500. Will update Figma.

sam: For charts, let's pick colorblind-safe trio: #E69F00, #56B4E9, #009E73. If we need a red-ish series, use #D55E00 instead of pure red. Also add pattern fill fallback for export/print.

anya: Small accessibility checklist I want attached to the PR: 1) WCAG contrast report 2) colorblind simulation images 3) screenshots at 13/14/16" 4) perf smoke test (no heavy box-shadows).

rachel: Microcopy: change the dark-theme switch aria-label to "Toggle theme: Dusk" and add accessible description.

design-bot: Tokens uploaded: "Dusk v2 (contrast pass)" by ellie at 2026-04-03T09:57Z. Link: https://figma.redwood/design/dusk-v2 :white_check_mark:

sam: I'll run the a11y CI and the screenshot diff after you push the PR.

anya: I'll run the colorblind checks and verify legend markers are distinct.

ellie: Thanks, everyone. I'll open a canary PR and ping this thread for final sign-off. :sparkles:
